## Wisp — G4 stallion

Wisp is the pale-yellow, blue-maned background stallion recognizable as the freezing Manehattan tourist **Rarity lends her scarf to** during “Generosity” in *Rarity Takes Manehattan*. He has blue eyes and, in some shots, a two-cluster green-grape cutie mark. He normally appears as an Earth pony; a winged lookalike appears in the same episode, with no established transformation or secret identity.

**Name:** “Wisp” is a **fan/wiki placeholder**, not a confirmed name spoken onscreen. Gameloft’s licensed mobile game uses **Manehattan Pedestrian** for a corresponding character (with lavender-tinted glasses); this is a game label, not proof the TV series officially named him.

**Scenes:** He starts as a passenger rescued from a runaway carriage by Mare Do Well (*The Mysterious Mare Do Well*, S2E8); shivers and accepts Rarity’s scarf (S4E8); joins the crowd criticizing Fluttershy’s friendship-journal portrayal (*Fame and Misfortune*, S7E14); and has later background appearances including *Molt Down* and *Growing Up Is Hard to Do*.

**Voice:** He does speak: “Oh, thank you, Mare Do We—”; “Wow, okay”; and “Why can't I be in the book?!” **Daniel Ingram** voiced the brief S4 scarf-scene line, as credited in voice documentation. Voice performers for his other lines are not securely verified.

**Sources:** [Character and naming](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Wisp) · [S2 transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/The_Mysterious_Mare_Do_Well) · [S4 transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Rarity_Takes_Manehattan) · [S7 transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Fame_and_Misfortune) · [Voice credit](https://www.behindthevoiceactors.com/tv-shows/My-Little-Pony-Friendship-is-Magic/Wisp/) · [Game label](https://mlp-gameloft.fandom.com/wiki/Manehattan_Pedestrian).
